entry_points.text: Registers huge states once; resolves zero page, validates bounce and config, activates allocator, releases init; checks shadow geometry; allocs tables or panics.
Parses early integer as boolean; installs trampoline alias and fixed maps unless at EL0; registers memory notifier when removal supported.
Suspend saves thread, exception, control, debug, offset, stack, platform; resume restores preserving address size, locks, access and keys.
Invalidates caches with barrier, blocks lower-privilege peripheral access, programs attributes from defaults adapted to probed features, returns control value.
Depth callbacks feed coalescer with end flush; boot builds bases, markers, registers view; transitional sync installs vectors or restarts, else stub error.

exports.text: Huge updates cover single and contiguous runs with delta check, flush clear on change, state carry, reinstall, erratum-aware prot bracketing and size check.
Zone limits derive DMA tops; early boot caps memory page-masked; checks gate confidential states, validate mapped extents, choose cacheability and remap rights.
Encryption hooks no-op without ops, warn misaligned, else delegate; exec setup anchors or randomizes direct and PLT windows and publishes default, probe and BPF ranges.
Pool splits to pages when needed; vmemmap checks window and section span for populate or free; hotplug add maps and instantiates with rollback, remove withdraws then unmaps.
Batch prot start and commit with single wrappers; key access checks support and range then merges perms; tag helpers save tagged pages by swap value and restore.
Vmalloc changers route read/write/exec via common validated updater with alias flush; direct-map toggles validity; presence probe walks kernel tables.
Top dirs alloc and free via pages or cache; address helpers translate linear and symbols with checks; dump builds bounded walk and debug read-only view.

hazards.text: Erratum exec changes need break-before-make; alloc and split fail panic; misalignment, present, reserved, malformed, bad extents and offline attempts warn or abort.
Live splits risk conflicts so stay page-granular; realm fail leaks pages; cross-CPU needs flag handshake with announce and spin until done.
Verification counts missing execute-never and writable-executable pages, warns once per class from range length.

invariants.text: Boot scales bounce, enforces compat and level checks, forces overcommit tiny; init release poisons and reserves range; table maps flag combos with privilege and tag tweaks.
Walks split larges to leaves; teardown clears hierarchy with range or per-page invalidate; mappable range uses window ends with wrap; edges splitting leaves fail closed.
Empty reclaim needs aligned containment, empty siblings, then clear, invalidate, free; release splits altmap and buddy with warnings; large clears conditional and drains children.
Rodata clears writability once, protects notes and text gaps, revokes alias; text follows rodata mode; dirs bypass cache when page-sized; bootmem scan warns unmarked.
Dump emits only with destination using match labels; boot walk disables output and passes only with zero execute-never and writable-executable violations.

locks.text: Spin lock guards top directory updates; mutex serializes fixed mappings; both static file scope.
Mutex serializes splits to leaves and pool splits; flag records break-before-make need for linear conversion.

state_machines.text: Boot waits parked secondaries, splits linear excluding alias, flushes, clears flag; secondaries use identity map; hibernate toggles alias validity on prepare and restore.
Bootstrap builds zeroed hierarchy and temp window, all switch via identity to remap, then frees scratch and enables non-global; secondaries park until flag clears.
Veto ignores non-offline, skips non-boot sections, rejects boot going-offline, flags already-offlined boot, rejects split-needing edges, else accepts.
Swap saves pages ordered, invalidates prefix on fail; restore walks incrementing; no-ops unsupported; realm breaks to invalid, asks host, restores validity.
Dumper tracks depth, prot, start, marker, normalizes folds, opens first, on change summarizes closed interval with size, level and protections.

structs.text: Shifts derive from level shifts with section alignment; bits forbid block, contiguous, executable; shadow aligns to table size with fixed prefix.
Boot table orders EL2 then EL1; after-init holds start, limits, offset, writability, bases; exec descriptor has per-use ranges with fallback; rodata defaults on.
Carrier holds set and clear masks clear-then-set; walker binds per-level leaf handlers with span checks; realm table binds encrypt and decrypt.
Temp window is negated one by middle shift; decode pairs masks with labels; five levels share it; vectors bind only privileged sync slot with two opcodes and stub error.
Context has paired register slots, platform slot, optional translation-control extension when present.
